name: gvl
title: Govee Lights
description: Control Govee LAN lights via gvl: power, color, temperature, modes, and sleep/wake schedules (local-only)
author: chris

commands.name: govee
commands.title: Govee Lights
commands.subtitle: Lights
commands.description: Power, brightness, color, temperature, animated modes, and sleep/wake schedules

commands.name: toggle
commands.title: Toggle Lights
commands.subtitle: Govee
commands.description: Toggle the Govee light. Live On/Off and color show as the command subtitle.

preferences.name: gvlPath
preferences.title: gvl path
preferences.description: Optional path to the gvl binary (leave empty to use PATH, ~/go/bin/gvl, or ~/.local/bin/gvl)

preferences.name: stepPercent
preferences.title: Brightness step
preferences.description: How much Ctrl+↑ / Ctrl+↓ adjusts brightness (percent)

preferences.name: directLan
preferences.title: Direct LAN
preferences.label: Skip gvld (talk UDP on this machine)
preferences.description: Passes --url local. Animated modes and schedules need gvld and will be disabled.
